messages:
maria: Heads-up - noticed an uptick in partial responses and client reconnects on prod-canary around 11:22 UTC. Many clients hit the 10s read timeout and retried immediately.
jon: can you drop the postmortem link?
maria: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/incident-2370003210 - short summary at top. Signals: partial_chunk_rate x8, concurrent live streams x2.
praveen: preliminary hypothesis: synchronized client retries + server-side keepalive/GC interactions -> bursts of partials and reconnect storms.
sasha: saw keepalive churn in nodepool-3, GC activity overlapped with many long-lived streams.
elena: canary I/O shows stalls ~9.6s before timeouts — borderline for our 10s read timeout.
praveen: suggested remediation plan, keep items small and measurable:
  - SDK backoff with jitter for immediate retries. owner: praveen, due: 2026-03-27.
  - Increase streaming keepalive 30s -> 60s on prod-canary, 4h soak. owner: sasha, due: 2026-03-25.
  - New metric partial_chunk_rate + alert at 0.5% over 1h. owner: elena, due: 2026-03-26.
  - Client telemetry for retry_attempts and last_retry_gap. owner: jon, due: 2026-03-28.
  - Canary dashboard tile combining partial_chunk_rate + KV cache evictions. owner: carlos, due: 2026-03-26.
maria: Agree. Stage changes so we can validate each.
praveen: SDK patch locally ready. Example snippet for Python: 
```
# python SDK: jittered exponential backoff
for attempt in range(max_retries):
    wait = base * (2 ** attempt) * random.uniform(1, 1.25)
    await sleep(wait)
```
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/989
jon: add a retry_attempts metric in the SDK to correlate spikes with partials. I'll own that.
ops-bot: deploy-note: canary config change window reserved 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC -> 06:00 UTC.
sasha: scheduling keepalive change in that window; will run 4-hour soak and attach raw metrics to the incident doc. Immediate rollback plan if regressions.
elena: I'll add the metric + alert and attach the alert JSON to the PR. Routing to pager-too.
carlos: I'll build the dashboard tile and add a synthetic test for partial responses during the soak.
maria: Add each task to the remediation tracker and update status when you start/complete. Tagging: @praveen @sasha @elena @jon @carlos :thumbsup:
praveen: Added checklist on incident issue: https://redwood.internal/ops/issues/2370003210 with owners and due dates.
jon: Proposal: short-term client-side circuit breaker to prevent >N immediate retries within M seconds to reduce hammering. owner: jon, due: 2026-03-28.
sasha: I'll monitor server fd counts and keepalive drift during soak.
maria: ops-bot created incident archive entry: incident-2370003210. Postmortem sync scheduled 2026-03-29 10:00 UTC. Success criteria: partial_chunk_rate < 0.2% after soak; otherwise escalate.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: postmortem-sync @ 2026-03-29T10:00:00Z.
carlos: I'll produce a heatmap correlating client retry timestamps with server GC timestamps to validate synchronized retry hypothesis. due: 2026-03-26.
elena: alert expression + threshold posted in PR comments.
praveen: will merge SDK retry change after CI tests pass; will coordinate with sasha for canary deploy.
maria: Thanks. Keep updates concise in this thread so on-call can follow. Closing loop for now but ping if blockers.
sasha: ack
carlos: ack
jon: ack
